name: Loop-SaboteurXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: A port of Loop Saboteur by Stephen McLeod Blythe (clickysteve): a glitch / chop / beat-slicer that records the last bars and replays them on the MPC tempo as retriggered, pitched, reversed, stretched and crushed slices. Eight Acts, a 64-step sequencer with trig conditions, ratchets and p-locks, and 19 factory presets.
